name: rap-sdk-typescript-compile-check
description: Stage-3 compile check for languages/typescript/core — strict tsc, no emit. The core is generated without package scaffolding (no npmName, pipeline/typescript/config.yaml) because it ships inside the runtime's package (runtime-tdd.md §2, one published package per language); this harness only proves the generated source compiles standalone. Not a publishable package and never becomes one — the npm identity is [Proposed] until OQ-3 and belongs to the runtime.
